_comment: The render goldens (Frank, 2026-11-08: a handful, requirement 3, no visual accident). Run from the repo root:
Each scene is loaded into one `ohao serve` and rendered with render.capture's parameters (`capture`), at the
size it is compared at (640x360: renders there are byte-identical run to run, the path tracer's too).
A golden is a hash of an unchanged renderer, not an image-quality gate: any change to the sample sequence moves every
pixel by the noise. Update (--update) only after looking at what drifted, and never widen a tolerance to make one pass.

scenes.name: cli_cornell_box_deferred
scenes._note: The game renderer (deferred, RT direct light, RT GI) on Cornell, 10 frames. Exact.

scenes.name: cli_cornell_box
scenes._note: The path tracer (rt_offline, 16 spp) on Cornell. Holds to the BVH floor: 1 level on a few pixels.

scenes.name: cli_damaged_helmet_deferred
scenes._note: A real glTF asset with normal, metal-rough and emissive maps, 30 frames with TAA and bloom. Exact.

scenes.name: cli_blockout_play_deferred
scenes._note: The play scene through the player's eyes before any step: level, skinned enemies, the view model. Exact.

scenes.name: cli_glass_deferred
scenes._note: Glass (clear, frosted, absorbing, thin-walled with a film) traced through in the deferred frame. Exact.
